policy: Every main product domain has an executable specification at its cheapest reliable layer. The manifest is checked after the TypeScript suite has passed; it is not a substitute for running the listed tests.

rules.name: deleted accounts lose REST and socket access
rules.title: rejects a valid REST token for a deleted user

rules.name: reading preferences never overwrites a newer snapshot
rules.title: does not write a stale snapshot

rules.name: failed preference bootstrap remains retryable without inventing state
rules.title: failed settings read remains retryable and does not invent preferences

rules.name: authentication stores only the session confirmed by the REST boundary
rules.title: records the confirmed session

rules.name: account lifecycle persists across reload, logout and login
rules.title: creates an account, reloads authenticated, logs out, and logs in again

rules.name: symbol-only titles still receive stable slugs
rules.title: generates non-empty slugs for symbol-only titles

rules.name: a parent with children requires and preserves an explicit child selection
rules.title: requires an explicit sub-intention and submits the preserved parent-child pair

rules.name: parent and sub-intention selection records a Timer
rules.title: enables Intentions, selects a Parent and Sub-intention, then records a Timer

rules.name: running sessions update remaining time deterministically
rules.title: updates running remaining time and existing session state deterministically

rules.name: advanced skip asks for a log decision only after elapsed work
rules.title: requires a log decision after elapsed work

rules.name: an extension remains attached to its originating session slot
rules.title: keeps an extension on the originating session marker

rules.name: primary Timer actions include undo and reset
rules.title: confirms primary Timer start, pause, add-five, undo, and reset actions

rules.name: long-break session state survives reload
rules.title: runs a Session through Long break and persists native Timer state across reload

rules.name: manual ordering changes an entire Intention family
rules.title: manual ordering updates one complete Intention family

rules.name: linked Intention changes are explicit confirmed Task updates
rules.title: makes linked intention selection an explicit confirmed Task update

rules.name: recurring Tasks cannot lose their required schedule
rules.title: protects recurrence scheduling

rules.name: completion preserves a recurring successor contract
rules.title: completes, undoes, and archives a recurring Task without violating its successor contract

rules.name: manual Task ordering survives refresh
rules.title: persists manual Task ordering across refresh

rules.name: server queues remain FIFO and isolated per user
rules.title: keeps FIFO order per user and isolates separate user queues

rules.name: client reconciliation precedes accepted-action resolution
rules.title: reconciles authoritative state before resolving an accepted action

rules.name: socket reconnect preserves accepted-action HTTP retry backoff until readiness
rules.title: does not preempt the HTTP retry backoff after socket connection

rules.name: delayed FIFO actions reconnect and reconcile authoritatively
rules.title: preserves accepted-action FIFO through delayed indication, reconnect, and authoritative reconciliation

rules.name: completed work records unique valid intention links
rules.title: records every selected intention once and retains only valid parent/sub-intention links

rules.name: deleting a work log refreshes history only after confirmed mutation
rules.title: deletes a selected recorded log, refreshes Timer history, and reports the confirmed change

rules.name: real activity produces statistics and work-Timer logs
rules.title: produces real Timer and Task activity for statistics and work-Timer logs

rules.name: import remaps IDs while preserving relationships
rules.title: assigns fresh IDs and remaps related imported rows

rules.name: administrator export and import restores complete data
rules.title: exports and imports complete user data as an administrator

domains.name: Watch HTTP contract and Wear state/presentation

rules.name: Watch status has stable timer Assistant and Task slots
rules.title: projects logged-in empty state into stable slots

rules.name: Watch accepted actions start and pause the authoritative Timer
rules.title: starts and pauses Timer through the accepted-action gateway

rules.name: Watch reconciliation follows the accepted-action workflow
rules.title: preserves accepted-action FIFO through delayed indication, reconnect, and authoritative reconciliation
